# The tier 3 path list. A pull request touching any of these needs a
# line-by-line read by the repository owner before it merges.
#
# Single source of truth, on purpose. This list used to live twice — as a grep
# pattern in tier-gate.yml and as a table in docs/WORKFLOW.md — and the failure
# mode of that arrangement is the worst one available: a path added to the
# document but not the pattern produces a gate that is documented and does not
# fire. tier-gate.yml builds its pattern from this file, and a test asserts the
# document lists exactly these entries.
#
# Matched as a prefix against paths from `git diff --name-only`, so a trailing
# slash covers a whole directory. Interpreted literally except that `.` is
# escaped, so do not put regular expressions here.
#
# Adding a line is itself a tier 3 change, because .github/ is on the list.

# Authorisation and configuration: a mistake here is invisible until someone
# who should not have access has it.
src/soma/serve/oauth.py
src/soma/config.py

# Secrets and the credential-minting script.
.env.example
scripts/agent_token.sh

# Deployment and CI: a mistake here reaches the Pi, or disables the checks
# that would have caught the next one.
.github/
deploy/
compose.pi.yaml
Dockerfile

# The rules an agent works under. These ship no code, but changing them
# changes every future pull request.
CLAUDE.md
docs/WORKFLOW.md
